Emergence of Induction Heads Across Seeds

Sean Trott

August 15, 2025

Load Pythia data

Here, we analyze summary data looking at the average attention each head gives from each token to the previous token.

Final-step attention

First token heads: a summary

df_by_head_seed = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(mpath) %>%
  mutate(z_ps = scale(mean_ps)) 


### Max by layer
df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(mpath, seed, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(mean_ps)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = seed,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Seed",
       fill = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(mpath, n_params))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'mpath', 'seed', 'layer'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.

### Max by layer

### How does *max* attention per layer change across model size?
df_layerwise_attn <- df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(mpath, layer, n_params, seed_name) %>%
  summarise(
    max_attention = max(z_ps),
    se_attention = sd(z_ps) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

### 
summary(lmer(data = df_layerwise_attn,
             max_attention ~ log10(n_params) * layer + (1|seed_name)))

Layer depth ratio

Where do these heads pop up?

df_pythia_models_final_step = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(max_layer = max(layer),
         prop_layer = layer / max_layer) %>%
  ### Scale for interpreting the coefficients more easily
  mutate(prop_layer_scaled = scale(prop_layer)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Summarize mean and SE by model and layer
summary_df <- df_pythia_models_final_step %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name, layer) %>%
  summarise(
    max_ratio_per_seed = max(mean_ps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_max_ratio = mean(max_ratio_per_seed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_max_ratio = sd(max_ratio_per_seed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = layer, y = avg_max_ratio, 
                       color = reorder(model, n_params))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = avg_max_ratio - se_max_ratio,
                  ymax = avg_max_ratio + se_max_ratio,
                  fill = reorder(model, n_params)), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Max Prefix-Matching Score",
       color = "Model", fill = "Model") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(4, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(4, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom")

Attention over time

Track AR Score

df_ar_by_step = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, seed, seed_name) %>%
  summarise(mean_ar_acc = first(mean_ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = first(mean_ar_rank))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'model', 'n_params', 'step_modded', 'seed'.
## You can override using the `.groups` argument.
summary_avg_ar = df_ar_by_step %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(mean_across_seeds = mean(mean_ar_acc))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'model', 'n_params'. You can override using
## the `.groups` argument.
df_ar_by_step %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded,
             y = mean_ar_acc,
             color = factor(seed_name))) +

            color = "black", size = 1.5) +

Research questions

Do bigger models show an earlier onset of their biggest change?

### First, try looking at first onset of a big change, trying out different ratios
### Calculate cross-step ratio
df_diff <- df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  group_by(mpath, seed_name) %>%
  arrange(step_modded) %>%
  mutate(
    log_step = log10(step_modded),
    d_ratio = c(NA, diff(mean_ps) / diff(log_step))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

summary(df_diff$d_ratio)
##      Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max.      NA's 
## -0.601292 -0.001766  0.000349  0.175770  0.007667  3.209977        36
# Define a range of d_ratio thresholds to test
d_ratio_thresholds <- seq(0.01, .3, by = 0.01)

# Initialize a list to store the results for each d_ratio threshold
results <- list()

# Iterate over d_ratio thresholds
for (threshold in d_ratio_thresholds) {
  # Filter and find the emergence onset for each threshold
  emergence_onset <- df_diff %>%
    filter(d_ratio > threshold) %>%
    group_by(model, seed_name, n_params) %>%  # Group by model size (n_params) and seed_name
    slice_min(step_modded, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Store the emergence step for each threshold, seed, and model size
  emergence_step_data <- emergence_onset %>%
    select(model, seed_name, n_params, step_modded, d_ratio) %>%
    mutate(d_ratio_threshold = threshold)  # Add the threshold as a column

  # Append the result for this threshold to the list
  results[[as.character(threshold)]] <- emergence_step_data
}

# Combine all the results into one data frame
results_df <- bind_rows(results)

results_summ = results_df %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, seed_name) %>%
  summarise(m_step = mean(step_modded - 1)) 
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'model', 'n_params'. You can override using
## the `.groups` argument.
### Plot average across d_ratio
results_summ %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_params,
             y = m_step,
             color = reorder(model, n_params))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 5, alpha = .7, width = .05) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(4, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Number of Parameters (Log10)",
       y = "Max. Deriv. Step (Log10)",
       color = "") 

### For each order magnitude in model size, how much sooner do we expect first onset on avearge?
mod_ratio = lmer(data = results_summ,
                 log10(m_step) ~ log10(n_params) + (1|seed_name))
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
summary(mod_ratio)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]

## REML criterion at convergence: 3

## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.4341 -0.7538  0.2501  0.8621  1.0363 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups    Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  seed_name (Intercept) 0.00000  0.0000  
##  Residual              0.05378  0.2319  
## Number of obs: 36, groups:  seed_name, 9
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                 Estimate Std. Error       df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)      8.91668    0.57370 34.00000  15.543  < 2e-16 ***
## log10(n_params) -0.71528    0.07197 34.00000  -9.939 1.36e-11 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

r.squaredGLMM(mod_ratio)

#### Now do it with GAMs: 
### at what point does the attention~step relationship start to change?
library(mgcv)
## Loading required package: nlme
## 
## Attaching package: 'nlme'
## 
## The following object is masked from 'package:lme4':
## 
##     lmList
## 
## The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     collapse

## This is mgcv 1.9-1. For overview type 'help("mgcv-package")'.
# Fit GAM across all models/seeds
df_by_head_max_attention$log_step = log10(df_by_head_max_attention$step_modded)
gam_all <- gam(mean_ps ~ s(log_step), data = df_by_head_max_attention)

# Summary of the GAM
summary(gam_all)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## mean_ps ~ s(log_step)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  0.27012    0.00538   50.21   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##               edf Ref.df     F p-value    
## s(log_step) 8.947  8.999 536.6  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.894   Deviance explained = 89.5%
## GCV = 0.016962  Scale est. = 0.01667   n = 576
# Plot the GAM curve
plot(gam_all)

### Now plot it over the original models
newdat_all <- tibble(
  log_step = seq(min(df_by_head_max_attention$log_step),
                 max(df_by_head_max_attention$log_step),
                 length.out = 200)
) %>%
  mutate(step_modded = 10^log_step,
         gam_pred = predict(gam_all, newdata = .))


# Plot seed-level + average + OVERALL GAM across all facets
grand_avg <- df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  group_by(step_modded) %>%
  summarise(grand_mean = mean(mean_ps))

df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded,
             y = mean_ps,
             color = factor(seed_name))) +
  geom_line(size = .6, alpha = .4) +   # individual curves
  geom_line(data = summary_avg, 
            aes(x = step_modded, y = mean_across_seeds), 
            color = "black", size = 2) +      # per-model average
  geom_line(data = grand_avg, aes(x = step_modded, y = grand_mean),
            color = "red", size = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step (Log10)",
       y = "Max Prefix-Matching Score",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(9, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params))

# Calculate centroids for each model size
centroids <- mds_by_step %>%
  group_by(n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    centroid_x = mean(x),
    centroid_y = mean(y),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate separation ratio for each model size
separation_stats <- centroids %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Distance to other centroids
    inter_dist = {
      current_params <- n_params
      other_centroids <- centroids %>% filter(n_params != current_params)
      mean(sqrt((other_centroids$centroid_x - centroid_x)^2 + 
                (other_centroids$centroid_y - centroid_y)^2))
    },
    # Within-cluster spread
    within_dist = {
      current_params <- n_params
      current_x <- centroid_x
      current_y <- centroid_y
      mds_by_step %>% 
        filter(n_params == current_params) %>%
        summarise(spread = mean(sqrt((x - current_x)^2 + (y - current_y)^2))) %>%
        pull(spread)
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(sep_ratio = inter_dist / within_dist) %>%
  ungroup()

print(separation_stats)

## 3 162322944     0.0259  -0.00346      0.0857     0.00543     15.8

##### Re-analysis with silhoeutte score


cor_mat <- df_wide %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("pythia-")) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - cor_mat)

# labels = model size, in the SAME column order as cor_mat
labels <- tibble(model_id = colnames(cor_mat)) %>%
  separate(model_id, into = c("model","seed_name"), sep = "-seed", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(df_params, by = "model") %>%
  pull(n_params)

clustering <- as.integer(factor(labels))

sil <- silhouette(clustering, dist_mat)
summary(sil)          # overall + PER-CLUSTER avg silhouette width
## Silhouette of 36 units in 4 clusters from silhouette.default(x = clustering, dist = dist_mat) :
##  Cluster sizes and average silhouette widths:
##           9           9           9           9 
##  0.92387356 -0.01321394  0.45120622  0.31485867 
## Individual silhouette widths:
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
## -0.9550  0.3808  0.5069  0.4192  0.7152  0.9527
stats <- cluster.stats(d = dist_mat, clustering = clustering)
stats$avg.silwidth    # silhouette
## [1] 0.4191811
stats$ch              # Calinski-Harabasz (note: your separation ratio ≈ this)
## [1] 796.0955
stats$dunn            # Dunn
## [1] 0.003509663
tibble(
  size = c("14M","70M","160M","410M"),
  avg_sil = summary(sil)$clus.avg.widths
)
## # A tibble: 4 × 2
##   size    avg_sil
##   <chr> <dbl[1d]>
## 1 14M      0.924 
## 2 70M     -0.0132
## 3 160M     0.451 
## 4 410M     0.315
### Permutation
observed <- cluster.stats(d = dist_mat, clustering = clustering)$avg.silwidth

set.seed(42)
null_sil <- replicate(5000, {
  cluster.stats(d = dist_mat, clustering = sample(clustering))$avg.silwidth
})
p_value <- (sum(null_sil >= observed) + 1) / (length(null_sil) + 1)

Alternative analysis using DTW

traj_mat <- df_wide %>%
  arrange(step_modded) %>%
  select(-step_modded)


model_ids <- colnames(traj_mat)

dtw_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = length(model_ids),
  ncol = length(model_ids),
  dimnames = list(model_ids, model_ids)
)

for(i in seq_along(model_ids)) {
  for(j in seq_along(model_ids)) {

    x <- traj_mat[[i]]
    y <- traj_mat[[j]]

    alignment <- dtw(
      x,
      y,
      distance.only = TRUE
    )

    dtw_mat[i, j] <- alignment$distance
  }
}

dtw_long <- as.data.frame(dtw_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Var1,
    names_to = "Var2",
    values_to = "dtw_distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = model_id_to_params),
    Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = model_id_to_params)
  )


dtw_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = dtw_distance)) +
  geom_tile() +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_replace(x, "pythia-", "")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_replace(x, "pythia-", "")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(
    title = "Prefix-matching convergence",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Distance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)

  # extract everything before the last " - " as the model
  mutate(
    model1 = str_replace(Var1, "-seed\\d+$", ""),
    model2 = str_replace(Var2, "-seed\\d+$", ""),
    same_model = model1 == model2
  ) %>% 
  mutate(same_exact = Var1 == Var2) %>%
  filter(same_exact == FALSE)

dtw_long = dtw_long %>%
  left_join(df_by_head_max_attention %>% ungroup() %>% select(model, n_params) %>% distinct(),
            by = c("model1" = "model")) %>%
  rename(n_params1 = n_params) %>%
  left_join(df_by_head_max_attention %>% ungroup() %>% select(model, n_params) %>% distinct(),
            by = c("model2" = "model")) %>%
  rename(n_params2 = n_params) 



### New analysis
dtw_long <- dtw_long %>%
  mutate(
    mean_log_params = (log10(n_params1) + log10(n_params2)) / 2,
    abs_diff_log_params = abs(log10(n_params1) - log10(n_params2))
  )

### Get unique ones
pairs_dtw <- dtw_long %>%
  filter(as.integer(Var1) < as.integer(Var2))

summary(lm(data = pairs_dtw,
           dtw_distance ~ mean_log_params + abs_diff_log_params))

Now with normalization:

traj_mat <- df_wide %>%
  arrange(step_modded) %>%
  select(-step_modded)


model_ids <- colnames(traj_mat)

dtw_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = length(model_ids),
  ncol = length(model_ids),
  dimnames = list(model_ids, model_ids)
)

for(i in seq_along(model_ids)) {
  for(j in seq_along(model_ids)) {
    x <- as.numeric(scale(traj_mat[[i]]))
    y <- as.numeric(scale(traj_mat[[j]]))
    alignment <- dtw(x, y, distance.only = TRUE)
    dtw_mat[i, j] <- alignment$normalizedDistance
  }
}

dtw_long <- as.data.frame(dtw_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Var1,
    names_to = "Var2",
    values_to = "dtw_distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = model_id_to_params),
    Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = model_id_to_params)
  )


dtw_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = dtw_distance)) +
  geom_tile() +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_replace(x, "pythia-", "")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_replace(x, "pythia-", "")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(
    title = "Prefix-matching convergence",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Distance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
  )
